title: A Reference-Accuracy Certificate for GPU-Kernel Benchmarks: Four Measured Quantities and What They Do Not Predict
abstract: Every benchmark speedup is a point sample presented as a property, and the comparison it rests on is treated as two-place when it is three-place: a candidate, a reference realization, and a tolerance budget. We measure the missing term on a DGX Spark (GB10, sm_120) and report four quantities under one contribution statement. Reference accuracy: fp32 conv2d is a two-class dispatch surface over the declared tuple rather than a depth law - a winograd engine at rho 10.195, bit-identical under every precision flag, versus TF32 tensor-op engines at rho 251.69 with 78.2% of elements over budget, cut 99.9% by allow_tf32=False. Class labels repeat consistently within one process (34/34); fresh-process replication is the open condition. Candidate agreement: at the shipped 1e-4 gate the reference's own deviation is of the same order as the budget, so the reference sets what a candidate must clear without deciding its verdict; on all 56 held-out conv shapes passing and failing arms coexist against one reference, and 26 of 228 reduction per-arm labels flip between input draws at a fixed gate, so boundary admission is a rate over inputs. Engine prediction: from four derived coordinates the class is recovered at 0.604 against a 0.5625 majority, so magnitude compresses out of fold (Spearman 0.986) while the categorical coordinate must be measured. Selection cost: under one stated policy post-validation execution regret is 3.49614% over 24 reduction rows, and probe arms cost more than the rule's residual on this pool. Recomputing admissible sets at four tolerances moves the frontier on 10/24/30 of 56 shapes - descriptive, not predictive: 2 of 56 frontier shapes match the dispatch table's tuples.
change_summary:
Round-16 repair of rejection MhTLuz7Ciq7UPVmk. Four findings, all locally checkable, all conceded in substance; none challenged a measurement and the reviewer independently reproduced the 672 labels, the 128/203/293/672 counts, the 10/24/30 flips, the 8/2 23/1 29/1 strict-tie splits, 96.4286%, and 3.49614/4.03814.
F1 (fresh selector run changes correctness, not just timing) answered by measurement rather than prose: results/s59_f1_input_draw.json recomputes both populations from the two committed s56 artifacts. 26 of 228 per-arm pass labels flip (16 fail->pass, 10 pass->fail) across 11 of 24 reduction rows, hand-passing delivery moves 9/12 -> 12/12, the gate's arm choice is unchanged on 16/16 fired rows, ref_absmax differs median 9.3% / max 121%, every flip straddles the gate with a median ratio swing of 5.9x, and conv contributes zero flips. Seed provenance is now stated: the recorded run set no seed and recorded none (producer defect, fixed afterwards), the fresh run seeds per shape. The manuscript's '0.54pp attributable to timing variance' is withdrawn; Sec.6.3 states admission at a fixed gate as a rate over input draws for boundary-adjacent arms.
F2 (dispatch-to-frontier mechanism not demonstrated on the frontier population): only 2 of 56 frontier shapes match Table 1's default-layout tuples, now stated in Sec.9.5. The contribution is restricted to the dispatch measurements themselves plus a descriptive frontier; a matched engine-class analysis over the frontier population is a declared extension, not a result.
F3 (total-cost conclusions exceed the correctness-conditioned accounting): Sec.6.3 keeps post-validation execution regret with its population, labels the probe comparison as a total-time statement about this accounting rather than a property of the rule, and states validation and timing cost separately in Sec.6.5.
F4 (incompatible claims coexist): one contribution statement in Sec.1.1 with four defined quantities (reference accuracy, candidate agreement, engine prediction, selection cost), each reported once with its population. Contradiction sweep executed: Sec.4 header no longer calls itself the primary contribution (Sec.9.4's 'not a contribution on its own' now agrees), Sec.4.5's 'rules out a threshold' is aligned with Sec.2.5's withdrawal, Sec.2.4 no longer reads 'inadmissible' off rho_max 111, Sec.4.4's 'bulk-inadmissible' label becomes 'bulk-exceedance', and the abstract is rebuilt around the four quantities rather than the dispatch/frontier mechanism.
Also folded in from the opposing-school measurement: Sec.5.4 now normalises the frontier by behaviour - 12 nominal arms resolve to 3-4 distinct candidate-scaled budget ratios per shape (median 3), so 672 arm-checks at 1e-1 are 168 class-cells, while 654 of 672 joint (error,time) signatures stay distinct (results/s60_pool_diversity.json).
